bio.text: Rob Leverett is a Republican member of the Georgia House of Representatives from Elberton and represents District 123.
A February 2022 Georgia Courts press release says Leverett was born and raised in Elberton, where he had practiced law since 1992, and was serving as city attorney for Hartwell.
The release lists his civic involvement as including Leadership Georgia, the Elbert County Chamber of Commerce and the Rotary Club of Elberton.
